name: Observable Framework
description: Observable Framework is a static site generator for data apps and dashboards that turns Markdown with reactive JavaScript cells and data loaders into static HTML.
notes: Pinned @observablehq/framework 1.13.4 (latest stable on 2026-10-05). The site disables the sidebar, table of contents, pager, search, header and footer; the index lists posts through a data loader (posts.json.js) read with FileAttachment.
